tools.name: search_diamonds
tools.description: Search certified diamonds listed by retailers worldwide, with the latest cross-retailer prices we have seen. Returns up to 10 stones with specs, the lowest and highest confirmed price for that exact stone with the date we last saw them, how many retailers list it and a Carat Hunter grade. Prices in US dollars. Retailer names are shown on carathunter.com after a free sign-up; always give the user the link.

tools.name: get_diamond
tools.description: Details and the latest confirmed price range for one diamond, with the date we last saw it, by its Carat Hunter id (from search_diamonds or a carathunter.com URL). For a diamond no longer listed, its record: the last listed price and that day (an asking price, not a recorded sale), the period Carat Hunter tracked it and how many retailers listed it.

tools.name: lookup_certificate
tools.description: Give the grading report number of a diamond (GIA, IGI, HRD, GCAL...) and get that stone's record on Carat Hunter. If retailers list it now: how many, and the price range between them as of the date we last saw it. If it is no longer listed: its last listed price and that day (an asking price, not a recorded sale), the period Carat Hunter tracked it and how many retailers listed it. Useful to check whether a quoted price is fair.

tools.name: price_check
tools.description: Typical listed prices for a spec (carat size, colour, clarity, shape, origin) across all retailers Carat Hunter tracks, with the day they were measured, as its insights page shows them: stones with a recently confirmed price, their median and typical range (10th to 90th percentile), how many retailers list them, and how much the same certified stone typically varies between retailers. Carat sizes: 0.3, 0.5, 0.75, 1, 1.5, 2, 3, 5 (each the start of a range: 1 covers 1.00 to 1.49ct).

tools.name: market_overview
tools.description: How many diamonds and retailers Carat Hunter currently tracks, from its latest weekly market report.
